    marker_points = []
    for val, count in counts.items():
        if val == bg:
            continue
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == val]
        if len(pts) == 4:
            rs = set(p[0] for p in pts)
            cs = set(p[1] for p in pts)
            if len(rs) == 2 and len(cs) == 2:
                marker_val = val
                marker_points = pts
                break
    
    if not marker_val:
        return grid
    
    # Compute marker bounding box
    r_min, r_max = min(p[0] for p in marker_points), max(p[0] for p in marker_points)
    c_min, c_max = min(p[1] for p in marker_points), max(p[1] for p in marker_points)
    
    H = r_max - r_min + 1
    W = c_max - c_min + 1
    
    # Initialize output with background
    out = [[bg for _ in range(W)] for _ in range(H)]
    
    # Place marker on complete border
    for r in range(H):
        out[r][0] = marker_val
        out[r][W-1] = marker_val
    for c in range(W):
        out[0][c] = marker_val
        out[H-1][c] = marker_val
    
    # Collect and map content to interior
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != marker_val:
                # Map relative to content's local frame
                r_rel = r - r_min
                c_rel = c - c_min
                if 1 <= r_rel < H-1 and 1 <= c_rel < W-1:
                    out[r_rel][c_rel] = grid[r][c]
    
    return out
